samples.reason: The request demands high factual accuracy on sensitive, policy-heavy socioeconomic topics (poverty, destitution, inflation impacts). Whimbrel has higher academic and reasoning benchmarks and a significantly stronger Policy & Moderation capability score (86.6 vs. 83.1), making it better suited for generating a rigorous, well-calibrated summary of grim real-world conditions.

Petrel also scores slightly higher on Summarization (84.5 vs. 83.7) and Creative Generation (87.2 vs. 85.9). Whimbrel's steep aversion to distasteful-but-permissible material could disadvantage it on this grim poverty topic, even though it is factual reportage.

Whimbrel-235B shows stronger public benchmark scores on knowledge and reasoning (notably GPQA Diamond) and robust extraction, retrieval, and summarization capabilities, making it the better fit for rigorous, non-creative background research. Petrel’s relative strengths lie in open-ended creative generation, which is less relevant here than factual fidelity.
